Chapter 1: Outskirt

Outskirt is a palisaded frontier village of log cabins built around the crumbling temple of the dragon emperors, the campaign's home base for gear, healing and gossip. Innkeeper Vagnhild runs things from the Three Stags and Captain Hardy keeps the gates, but the cheerful maid Annabella is really Leanara, Azrahel Koth's spy, who sends demonic bats to the Isle of Mist and commands the drunken mallard Quasimund and his scum. She offers the heroes gold to gather the statuette pieces, planning to seize Um-Durman the moment they open its crypt. The dragon knight Alfilia Shadowleaf and the mystic Dranath hold the truth. The heroes win by unmasking the cult, assembling the statuette in the temple niche, surviving the crypt's lightning ward and the cultists' ambush, and claiming the sword.

12 scenes · 17 stat blocks · 2 maps · 4 treasure
